# singularskills

> Structured, repeatable workflows for digital production domains. 303 skills across 18 domains, in one pack of agent skills.

## Overview

singularskills is one pack of agent skills (plain SKILL.md folders in the Agent Skills format) that brings structured, repeatable workflows to digital production domains. Each domain implements an established industry methodology as skills (structured prompts), ordered into phases by workflow files. The `workflow` skill runs a workflow phase by phase and stops for approval at every boundary. Artifacts are written to `.singularskills/<workflow>/<project>/`, and a run log to `.singularskills/log.jsonl`.

## Install

```
npx skills add bromso/singularskills
```

Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add bromso/singularskills`, then `/plugin install singularskills@singularskills`.
Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add bromso/singularskills`, then `codex plugin add singularskills@singularskills`.

## Domains

Skill names are `<domain>-<skill>`, for example `design-empathize`.

- Design: Design Thinking (empathize, define, ideate, prototype, test)
- Research: Double Diamond (discover, define, design, deliver)
- Analytics: Decision Analytics Cycle (questions, metrics, data audit, analysis, dashboards, readout, plus experiment-readout, investigate, number-check, query)
- Development: Dev Workflow (plan, build, test, debug, review, ship)
- Marketing: RACE Framework (strategy, reach, act, convert, engage)
- Branding: Brand Lifecycle (discover, strategy, verbal, visual, guidelines, audit)
- Accessibility: WCAG-EM (scope, evaluate, report, remediate, retest, checklist)
- Project Management: Scrum (initiate, plan, sprint, review, improve)
- Coaching: Domain Coaching (ux, code, copy, a11y, strategy)
- Leadership: Leadership Dev (assess, vision, build, develop, sustain + 7 tools)
- Legal: Legal Lifecycle (assess, draft, review, comply, govern)
- Security: NIST CSF 2.0 (govern, identify, protect, detect, respond, recover)
- Compliance: GRC Lifecycle (scope, assess, remediate, certify, monitor)
- Bookkeeping: Bookkeeping Cycle (record, categorize, reconcile, report)
- Accounting: Accounting Cycle (analyze, journal, ledger, trial-balance, adjust, statements, close)
- Finance: FP&A (assess, plan, forecast, budget, model, review)
- Support: Support Operations Cycle (map, taxonomy, knowledge, responses, escalation, service levels, health, plus reply, qa-review, incident-update)
- Singular: the workflow conductor plus singular-status, singular-init, singular-report, singular-detect, singular-find-skill, singular-create-skill, singular-improve-skill

## Links

- Documentation: https://bromso.github.io/singularskills/
- GitHub: https://github.com/bromso/singularskills

## Compatibility

Tier 1, tested per release: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, GitHub Copilot (VS Code and CLI), Gemini CLI, Kimi Code CLI. Any other agent supported by `npx skills add` works through the universal installer.
